[[File:Christof Schütte.jpg|thumb|right|Christof Schütte]]
'''Christof Schütte''' (born April 10, 1966) is a German [[mathematician]], working in applied and computational mathematics at the [[Freie Universität Berlin]] and the [[:de:Konrad-Zuse-Zentrum für Informationstechnik Berlin|Zuse Institute Berlin]].

==Education and career==
Christof Schütte was born in [[Warburg]]. He graduated in physics from [[Universität Paderborn|Paderborn University]] in 1991 and then obtained his PhD in mathematics under the supervision of [[:de:Peter Deuflhard|Peter Deuflhard]] in 1994. He is currently{{when|date=April 2019}} a Professor in Numerical Mathematics and Scientific Computing at [[Freie Universität Berlin]], and the president of the [[:de:Konrad-Zuse-Zentrum für Informationstechnik Berlin|Zuse Institute Berlin]].

Schütte has been one of the driving forces behind the [[:de:Matheon|Research Center “Mathematics for Key Technologies” (MATHEON)]] and has been its co-chair since 2008. Since 2015, he has acted as the head of the [http://www.forschungscampus-modal.de Research Campus MODAL], a public-private partnership between mathematics research institutes and 15 industrial companies, and as the co-chair of the [https://www.ecmath.de Einstein Center for Mathematics in Berlin].

2021 Schütte has been elected chairman of the board of the NHR association (Verein für Nationales Hochleistungsrechnen e.V. - NHR-Verein).

==Research==
Schütte's research has focused on multiscale modelling and simulation for complex systems, numerical mathematics, data-driven modelling and statistical learning with applications in the natural, materials and [[Life Sciences|life sciences]]. He is a co-inventor of the transfer operator approach<ref>[http://publications.imp.fu-berlin.de/129/1/SC-99-36.pdf Transfer operator approach].</ref> to [[metastability]] that has led to the development of widely used computational methods like [[Markov state model]]s<ref>{{cite journal | pmc=2933958 | date=2010 | last1=Pande | first1=V. S. | last2=Beauchamp | first2=K. | last3=Bowman | first3=G. R. | title=Everything you wanted to know about Markov State Models but were afraid to ask | journal=Methods | volume=52 | issue=1 | pages=99–105 | doi=10.1016/j.ymeth.2010.06.002 | pmid=20570730 }}</ref> in molecular dynamics or the (extended) dynamic mode decomposition.

Schütte has been an invited speaker at the [[International Congress on Industrial and Applied Mathematics|International Council for Industrial and Applied Mathematics]] (ICIAM) in [[Zürich]], 2007, and at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians]] (ICM) in [[Hyderabad]], 2010.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Schütte, Prof. Dr. Christof|url=https://www.zib.de/members/schuette |access-date=2022-07-15 |website=zib.de}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|last1=Djurdjevac|first1=Natasa|last2=Sarich|first2=Marco|last3=Schütte|first3=Christof|chapter=On Markov State Models for Metastable Processes|title=Proceedings of the International Congress of Mathematicians 2010 Hyderabada|volume=IV|year=2011|pages=3105–3131|doi=10.1142/9789814324359_0182|isbn=978-981-4324-30-4}}</ref>

==Publications==
Christof Schütte has published more than 150 articles in scientific journals.<ref>[http://www.zib.de/members/schuette List of publications].</ref>
